resources.string: Mika audio helper

Android handles regular calls. Mika uses the audio helper to hear and speak in AI calls. Wireless debugging lets this phone start or restore the helper without a computer. Join Wi-Fi for pairing; live AI voice also needs an internet connection.
The audio helper cannot be set up on this device.
Android does not provide the settings needed to start the helper here. Regular calls still work through your phone app.

Pair once on this phone to start the helper again without a computer if it stops. Connect to Wi-Fi for setup.

If wireless setup is unavailable and you have a computer, connect a USB cable and run this command on the computer. You may need to run it again after an update or restart.
If the helper stops, join Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging if Android has switched it off. Pair again only if asked.
Join Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options. Tap Allow if Android asks. Then return to Mika to continue to the pairing code step.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging and confirm. You do not need to plug in a cable for wireless setup. Leave other settings alone.
No cable needed for wireless setup
